prompt: My requests to the Example API started failing with HTTP 429 and the error code rate_limited. What should I do? Answer from the example-docs documentation in three short sentences, and cite the page URL.
answer:
You hit the rate limit: standard plans allow 100 requests per minute, and enterprise plans allow 1000. Read the `X-RateLimit-Reset` header on the 429 response, and wait until that time before you retry. Check `X-RateLimit-Remaining` on each response to slow down before you reach the limit.

Source: https://example.com/docs/api/endpoints (section "Rate Limiting")
